sources.review: Cover and page 2: instrument exterior, top ribs, detector caps, scan controls, front access ports. Installed Smart accessories are excluded from the bare instrument.

Printed pp. 33-34 describe the sliding sample door; p. 51 locates it in the hinged cover; pp. 91-93 distinguish cover, fixed front wall, two interior 15-contact connectors and purge outlet. p. 95 lists the Detector/Motors pinout. PDF pp. 57 and 98 illustrations were inspected.

inferences: Local shell profiles, corner radii, ribs, ventilation and control dimensions are photograph-derived, not measured CAD.
Hinge and sliding-door mechanisms are documented; hinge datum, slider travel, handle dimensions and mount geometry are inferred and need contact qualification.

No IntegratIR, ATR or Smart accessory is included in this bare-instrument asset.
